correctness.rationale: The discriminant gives exactly 101 squarefree genus-four models. A complete exact arithmetic data table is independently reconstructed over each F_(11^n) for n=1,...,4 using two irreducible quotient presentations, every element and every marked parameter. Newton identities plus the genus-four functional equation uniquely recover each degree-eight zeta numerator. A packaged checker verifies the 69 class multiplicities and the 11-rank histogram, with the two rank-zero members sharing one exactly factored supersingular numerator; direct Cartier coefficient elimination gives a-number two. Unproved limits concern extension-parameter families, not this finite table.

value.rationale: This is a complete isogeny-class classification, not a routine special value: the naturally normalized C6 genus-four family has a substantial superspecial literature, and the first p=11 nonsuperspecial region exhibits two exactly classified supersingular-but-not-superspecial Jacobians sharing a Weil type. The 69 exact types and 11-rank distribution quantify arithmetic variation for all 101 smooth marked members; full zeta functions determine all extension point counts for each curve.
